items.english: WE HAVE NO PATIENCE FOR YOUR FOOLISHNESS.  YOU WILL COOPERATE WITH US OR YOU WILL BE DESTROYED.

items.english: AS REPRESENTATIVES OF THE PEOPLE OF ARTH WE EXTEND OUR BEST WISHES AND OUR HOPE FOR EQUITABLE RELATIONS IN THE FUTURE.

items.english: ...THE VIRUS SPREAD LIKE BURNING FIRE, THE SEA OF DREAD ROSE HIGHER AND HIGHER.  THE CRYSTAL ONES HAD TO FIGHT BY CAUSING SUNS TO IGNITE.  SELF-DEFENSE, IT IS THEIR RIGHT...

items.english: ...AND HARDER STILL TO RECOGNIZE THAT WHICH LIES BEFORE ONE\S EYES.  SO MANY RACES HAVE BELIEVED IN ONLY WHAT WAS PRECONCEIVED. THAT WHICH IS ANCIENT MAY BE NEW, IT ALL DEPENDS ON POINT OF VIEW...

items.portuguese: O QUE VOCE DESEJA SABER NAO E DE IMPORTANCIA.  VOCE PERDEU MEU TEMPO.

items.english: I BEG YOUR FORGIVENESS BUT I DO NOT KNOW ABOUT THIS.  PERHAPS YOU WOULD LIKE TO KNOW MORE ABOUT US SPEMIN.

items.portuguese: E COMPREENSIVEL QUE VOCE DESEJA SABER SOBRE NOS.  TODAS AS RACAS DA GALAXIA INVEJA E NOS ADMIRE COMO VOCE FAZ.

items.english: WE ARE THE CHOSEN BLOBS, CHILDREN OF THE GREAT BLOB GODDESS, GURTBLUNK.  UNTO US SHE SPEWS HER LOVE IN NEVER ENDING CHUNKS.
items.portuguese: SOMOS OS BLOBS ESCOLHIDOS, FILHOS DA GRANDE DEUSA BLOB, GURTBLUNK.  PARA NOS ELA EXPLORA SEU AMOR EM PEDACOS SEM FIM.

items.english: THE BLOB GODDESS HAS ORDAINED THAT WE SHALL RULE ALL INFERIOR BEINGS.  YOU HAVE FEWER THAN SEVEN EYES.  YOU CANNOT OOZE.  YOU LACK THE MOST RUDIMENTARY SLIME.  YOU ARE CLEARLY INFERIOR BEINGS.
items.portuguese: A DEUSA BLOB ORDENOU QUE DEVEMOS GOVERNAR TODOS OS SERES INFERIORES.  VOCE TEM MENOS DE SETE OLHOS.  VOCE NAO PODE ESGOTAR.  VOCE FALTA O SLIME MAIS RUDIMENTAR.  VOCES SAO SERES CLARAMENTE INFERIORES.

items.english: AMONG US THERE IS A SAYING - MORE SPEMIN...GOOD, FEWER SPEMIN...BAD.  OF COURSE WE REPRODUCE BY BUDDING.  THE FIRST COMMANDMENT OF THE GREAT BLOB GODDESS IS - DIVIDE AND MULTIPLY.
items.portuguese: ENTRE NOS HA UM DIZER - MAIS SPEMIN...BOM, MENOS SPEMIN...RUIM.  E CLARO QUE REPRODUZIMOS POR BOTAO.  O PRIMEIRO MANDAMENTO DA GRANDE DEUSA BLOB E - DIVIDIR E MULTIPLICAR.

items.english: NO DOUBT YOU WISH TO BECOME A SLAVE RACE OF THE SPEMIN.  WE ARE A RACE OF HIGH MORALS AND ARE AGAINST SLAVERY, BUT SINCE YOU FEEL SO STRONGLY ABOUT IT WE MAY BE WILLING TO MAKE AN EXCEPTION.
items.portuguese: SEM DUVIDA VOCE DESEJA SE TORNAR UMA RACA ESCRAVA DO SPEMIN.  SOMOS UMA RACA DE MORAL ALTA E SOMOS CONTRA A ESCRAVIDAO, MAS COMO VOCE SE SENTE TAO FORTE SOBRE ISSO, PODEMOS ESTAR DISPOSTOS A FAZER UMA EXCECAO.

items.english: OF COURSE YOU STARE IN WONDERMENT AT OUR BEAUTIFUL ANTENNAE.  THESE ANTENNAE ALLOW US TO GET 32 CHANNELS WITH NO NEED FOR CABLE.  IN ADDITION THEY PICK UP THE COSMIC VIBRATIONS THAT GIVE US OUR GOD-LIKE POWERS.  THEY ALSO HAPPEN TO BE VERY FASHIONABLE.
items.portuguese: E CLARO QUE VOCE OLHA MARAVILHOSO PARA NOSSAS LINDAS ANTENAS.  ESTAS ANTENAS PERMITEM OBTER 32 CANAIS SEM NECESSIDADE DE CABO.  ALEM DISSO, ELES CAPTAM AS VIBRACOES COSMICAS QUE NOS DAO OS NOSSOS PODERES DIUS.  ELES TAMBEM ESTAO MUITO NA MODA.

items.english: THERE IS A SAYING AMONG THE SPEMIN THAT SUMS UP OUR WHOLE PHILOSOPHY OF LIFE.  IT IS - BLUKBLUK DURT, SMEG!  ROUGHLY TRANSLATED IT MEANS  \QUIVERING PARTICLE SECRETES ENZYME.\  THIS IS JUST A ROUGH TRANSLATION.
items.portuguese: HA UM DIZER ENTRE OS SPEMIN QUE RESUME TODA A NOSSA FILOSOFIA DE VIDA.  E - BLUKBLUK DURT, SMEG!  TRADUZIDO APROXIMADAMENTE, SIGNIFICA PARTICULAS QUIVERING SECRETAS ENZIMA. ESTA E APENAS UMA TRADUCAO APROXIMADA.

items.english: HISTORICAL FACT SHOWS US THAT THE SPEMIN ONCE RULED THE OLD EMPIRE.  THE FACTS SHOW US THAT THE HUMANS WERE OUR SUBJECTS.... I MEAN OUR SERVANTS.... I MEAN OUR SLAVES.  YES, THAT\S IT; THE FACTS SHOW US THAT THE HUMANS WERE OUR SLAVES.
items.portuguese: O FATO HISTORICO MOSTRA-NOS QUE O SPEMIN JA GOVERNOU O ANTIGO IMPERIO.  OS FATOS NOS MOSTRAM QUE OS HUMANOS ERA NOSSOS SUBITOS.... QUERO DIZER NOSSOS SERVOS.... QUERO DIZER NOSSOS ESCRAVOS.  SIM, E ISSO; OS FATOS NOS MOSTRAM QUE OS HUMANOS FORAM NOSSOS ESCRAVOS.

items.english: NO OTHER RACE CAN KNOW THE PLEASURES OF A SPEMIN.  AHH, TO ENGULF A FRESH GLOB OF PROTEIN SUBSTANCE, TO BOUNCE A NEWLY BUDDED BLOBBIE ON ONE\S PSEUDOPOD.  TRULY THE OTHER RACES ARE DEPRIVED.
items.portuguese: NENHUMA OUTRA RACA PODE CONHECER OS PRAZERES DE UM SPEMIN.  AHH, PARA ENGULAR UM GLOBO FRESCO DE SUBSTANCIA PROTEINA, PARA SALTAR UM BLOBBIE RECEM-GRAMADO NO SEU PSEUDOPODE.  VERDADEIRAMENTE AS OUTRAS RACAS SAO PRIVADAS.

items.english: WE SPEMIN LIVE TO THE AGE OF 600.  SOME OF THE OLDEST SPEMIN PERHAPS TO 1000.  IN YOUR ARTH YEARS THIS WOULD EQUATE TO....UH....APPROXIMATELY....4.
items.portuguese: NOS SPEMIN VIVEMOS ATE A IDADE DE 600. ALGUNS DOS SPEMIN MAIS VELHOS TALVEZ ATE 1000. EM SEUS ANOS DE ARTE, ISSO EQUIVALERA A.... UH.... APROXIMADAMENTE....4.

items.english: THE BRAIN OF A SPEMIN IS THE MOST COMPLEX THING IN THE UNIVERSE.  IN FACT, IT IS SO COMPLEX THAT OUR SPEMIN DOCTORS HAVE, AS YET, BEEN UNABLE TO DETERMINE THE EXACT LOCATION OF IT IN THE SPEMIN BODY.
items.portuguese: O CEREBRO DE UM SPEMIN E A COISA MAIS COMPLEXA DO UNIVERSO.  DE FATO, E TAO COMPLEXO QUE NOSSOS MEDICOS DE SPEMIN, AINDA, NAO FORAM CAPAZES DE DETERMINAR A LOCALIZACAO EXATA DELE NO CORPO DE SPEMIN.

items.english: YOU WISH TO KNOW ABOUT THE MIGHTY SPEMIN?  DROP YOUR DEFENSES AND WE SHALL TEACH YOU.
items.portuguese: VOCE DESEJA SABER SOBRE O PODEROSO SPEMIN?  ABAIXE SUAS DEFESAS E NOS TE ENSINAMOS.

items.english: YOU SHALL SOON LEARN MORE THAN YOU WOULD CARE TO KNOW ABOUT THE ALMIGHTY SPEMIN.
items.portuguese: EM BREVE VOCE APRENDERA MAIS DO QUE GOSTARIA DE SABER SOBRE O TODO-PODEROSO SPEMIN.

items.english: VERY WELL, WE ARE THE OLDEST RACE AND THE YOUNGEST, THE WISEST AND THE MOST INNOCENT, THE STRONGEST AND THE WEAKEST.  WE ARE ALSO THE MOST CLEVER.  WE ARE, IN FACT, SO CLEVER THAT EVEN WE CANNOT UNDERSTAND WHAT WE SAY.
items.portuguese: MUITO BEM, SOMOS A RACA MAIS VELHA E A MAIS JOVEM, A MAIS SABIA E A MAIS INOCENTE, A MAIS FORTE E A MAIS FRACA.  SOMOS TAMBEM OS MAIS INTELIGENTES.  SOMOS, DE FATO, TAO INTELIGENTES QUE NEM NOS PODEMOS ENTENDER O QUE DIZEMOS.

items.english: CERTAINLY OUR RACES HAVE BEEN FRIENDS SINCE ANCIENT TIMES.  IN THE WAR OF THE FIRST WAVE WE FOUGHT AS ALLIES AGAINST THE PHLEGMAK AND NUMLOX, SIDE BY SIDE, BACK TO BACK, SINGING OUR SONGS OF FRIENDSHIP.
items.portuguese: CERTAMENTE NOSSAS RACAS SAO AMIGAS DESDE OS TEMPOS ANTIGOS.  NA GUERRA DA PRIMEIRA ONDA LUTAMOS COMO ALIADOS CONTRA O PHLEGMAK E O NUMLOX, LADO A LADO, DE COSTAS COM COSTAS, CANTANDO NOSSAS CANCOES DE AMIZADE.

items.english: OUR RACE WORSHIPS AND HONORS YOUR KIND.  HOW WONDERFUL IT MUST BE TO BE STIFF AND UPRIGHT.  WE LOOK UPON YOU ALMOST AS GODS.  NO, AS MORE THAN GODS, AS.... WELL, WHATEVER IS MORE THAN A GOD.
items.portuguese: NOSSA RACA ADORA E HONRA SUA TIPO.  COMO DEVE SER MARAVILHOSO SER RIGIDO E ERTO.  NOS OLHAMOS PARA VOCES QUASE COMO DEUSES.  NAO, COMO MAIS QUE DEUSES, COMO... BEM, O QUE E MAIS QUE UM DEUS.

items.english: IN THE YEAR 2675 THE OLD EMPIRE DISCOVERED OUR HOMEWORLD AND UPLIFTED US FROM A STATE OF MORAL, INTELLECTUAL, AND EMOTIONAL DEPRAVITY TO THE DIVINE STATE WE ARE IN NOW.  WE HAVE BEEN MEANING TO THANK YOU.
items.portuguese: NO ANO DE 2675, O VELHO IMPERIO DESCOBRIU NOSSO MUNDO LAR E ELEVOU-NOS DE UM ESTADO DE DEPRAVIDADE MORAL, INTELECTUAL E EMOCIONAL PARA O ESTADO DIVINO EM QUE ESTAMOS AGORA.  QUEREMOS AGRADECER.

items.english: WE HAVE BEEN UNJUSTLY PICKED ON BY ALL OF THE OTHER RACES.  WE MEAN WELL, AND ONLY WANT TO BE LIKED, BUT ALL THE OTHER RACES IN THE GALAXY KEEP MISINTERPRETING OUR INTENTIONS AND BLOWING UP OUR SHIPS FOR NO REASON.
items.portuguese: FOMOS ESCOLHIDOS INJUSTAMENTE POR TODAS AS OUTRAS RACAS.  NOS SIGNIFICAMOS BEM, E SO QUEREMOS SER GOSTOSOS, MAS TODAS AS OUTRAS RACAS DA GALAXIA CONTINUAM MAL INTERPRETANDO NOSSAS INTENCOES E EXPLODIM NOSSAS NAVES SEM MOTIVO.

items.english: WE\RE REALLY JUST A HAPPY-GO-LUCKY RACE OF ZANY GUYS.  I KNOW, CALL US CRAZY, BUT I GUESS WE\RE PRETTY LOVABLE.
items.portuguese: NOS SOMOS REALMENTE APENAS UMA CORRIDA DE SORTE DE CARAS DOIS.  EU SEI, NOS CHAME DE LOUCOS, MAS ACHO QUE SOMOS MUITO AMAVEIS.

items.english: DO NOT WASTE OUR TIME WITH UNIMPORTANT QUESTIONS.  OBVIOUSLY OURS IS THE ONLY IMPORTANT RACE.
items.portuguese: NAO PERCA NOSSO TEMPO COM PERGUNTAS SEM IMPORTANCIA.  OBVIAMENTE A NOSSA E A UNICA RACA IMPORTANTE.

items.english: YOU DARE ASK US ABOUT OTHER RACES?  YOUR IMPUDENCE IS BEYOND BELIEF.
items.portuguese: VOCE OUSA PERGUNTAR-NOS SOBRE OUTRAS RACAS?  SUA IMPUDENCIA ESTA ALEM DA CRENCA.

items.english: WE DO NOT KNOW A GREAT DEAL ABOUT OTHER RACES.  FOR SOME STRANGE REASON THEY TEND TO STAY AWAY FROM US.  OF COURSE WE WILL GLADLY TELL YOU WHAT WE KNOW.
items.portuguese: NAO SABEMOS MUITO SOBRE OUTRAS RACAS.  POR ALGUM MOTIVO ESTRANHO, ELES TENDEM A FICAR LONGE DE NOS.  E CLARO QUE TEREMOS PRAZER EM CONTAR O QUE SABEMOS.

items.english: THE VELOX ARE AN ARROGANT RACE OF INSECTS.  WE HAVE FOUND THAT BY PRETENDING TO WORSHIP THEM SOMETIMES THEY WILL NOT DESTROY US.  OF COURSE YOU MUST NOT THINK WE ARE ONLY PRETENDING TO WORSHIP YOU, *.  I GIVE YOU THE SPEMIN WORD OF HONOR.
items.portuguese: OS VELOX SAO UMA RACA ARROGANTE DE INSETOS.  DESCOBRIMOS QUE, AO FINGIR QUE OS ADORAMOS, AS VEZES, ELES NAO NOS DESTRUIRAO.  E CLARO QUE VOCE NAO DEVE PENSAR QUE ESTAMOS SO FINGINDO ADORA-LO, *.  DOU-LHE A PALAVRA DE HONRA DE SPEMIN.

items.english: THERE IS A RACE OF MACHINE HUMANS.  WE DO NOT UNDERSTAND THEIR BEHAVIOR.  THERE IS ALSO THE PLANT RACE AND THE REPTILE RACE.  THESE RACES HATE AND DESPISE EACH OTHER.  THEY FIGHT AND KILL.  THIS WE UNDERSTAND.
items.portuguese: HA UMA RACA DE HUMANOS MAQUINAS.  NAO ENTENDEMOS SEU COMPORTAMENTO.  HA TAMBEM A RACA DAS PLANTAS E A RACA DOS REPTEIS.  ESTAS RACAS ODEIAM-SE E DESPREZAM-SE.  ELES LUTAM E MATAM.  ISSO NOS ENTENDEMOS.

items.english: THE GAZURTOID ARE A RACE OF AQUATIC CREATURES WHO ARE WHAT YOU MIGHT CALL.... INSANE FANATICS.  THEY BELIEVE IT IS THEIR DESTINY TO CLEANSE THE UNIVERSE OF, IF WE MAY USE THEIR TERM, \BLASPHEMING HERETICAL LOW-LIFE AIR-BREATHING SCUMDOGS.\
items.portuguese: OS GAZURTOID SAO UMA RACA DE CRIATURAS AQUATICAS QUE SAO O QUE VOCE PODE CHAMAR.... FANATICOS INSANOS.  ELES ACREDITAM QUE E SEU DESTINO LIMPAR O UNIVERSO DE, SE PUDERMOS USAR SEU TERMO, \BLASFEMAR OS SCUMDOGS HERETICOS, DE BAIXA VIDA, QUE RESPIRAM AR.\

items.english: AS YOU MUST KNOW, THE NUMLOX AND PHLEGMAK WERE THE FIRST RACES TO ATTACK FROM THE CORE.  LATER CAME THE UHLEK AND THE GAZURTOID.  WHEN THE OLD EMPIRE SPURNED US, THEIR LOVING AND DEVOTED CHILDREN, WE WERE FORCED TO PRETEND ALLEGIANCE WITH THE GAZURTOID.
items.portuguese: COMO VOCE DEVE SABER, O NUMLOX E O PHLEGMAK FORAM AS PRIMEIRAS RACAS A ATACAR DO NUCLEO.  DEPOIS VEIO O UHLEK E ??O GAZURTOID.  QUANDO O VELHO IMPERIO NOS REJEITOU, SEUS AMOROSOS E DEVOTOS FILHOS, FOMOS FORCADOS A FINGIR LEALDADE COM O GAZURTOID.

items.english: ALL THE GAZURTOID EVER DO IS SPOUT THEIR RELIGIOUS RHETORIC.  BEING DIABOLICALLY CLEVER WE HAVE MANAGED TO CONVINCE THEM THAT WE ARE WATER BREATHERS.  WE HAVE DONE THIS BY SITTING IN POOLS OF WATER WHENEVER WE COMMUNICATE WITH THEM.
items.portuguese: TUDO QUE O GAZURTOID FAZ E DIZER SUA RETORICA RELIGIOSA.  SENDO DIABOLICAMENTE INTELIGENTES, CONSEGUIMOS CONVENCE-LOS DE QUE SOMOS RESPIRADORES DE AGUA.  FIZEMOS ISSO SENTANDO-NOS EM PISCINAS DE AGUA SEMPRE QUE NOS COMUNICAMOS COM ELES.

items.english: THE GAZURTOID POSSESS EFFECTIVE SHIELDING AGAINST MISSILES.  IT IS NECESSARY TO ATTACK THEM WITH LASERS.  OUR BRILLIANT SCIENTISTS ARE WORKING ON THIS PUZZLE.  THEY ARE JUST ON THE VERGE OF A MAJOR BREAKTHROUGH.
items.portuguese: OS GAZURTOID POSSUEM PROTECAO EFICAZ CONTRA MISSEIS.  E NECESSARIO ATACA-LOS COM LASERS.  NOSSOS CIENTISTAS BRILHANTES ESTAO TRABALHANDO NESTE ENIGMA.  ELES ESTAO A BEIRA DE UM GRANDE AVANCO.

items.english: OF COURSE THE GAZURTOID ARE REALLY NO MATCH FOR OUR WARSHIPS.  IN FACT, THEY COPIED THE DESIGN FROM US.  THE UHLEK, ON THE OTHER HAND COME A LITTLE CLOSER TO MATCHING OUR STRENGTH.
items.portuguese: E CLARO QUE OS GAZURTOID NAO SAO COMPARADOS COM NOSSAS NAVES DE GUERRA.  NA FATO, ELES COPIARAM O PROJETO DE NOS.  O UHLEK, POR OUTRO LADO, CHEGOU UM POUCO MAIS PERTO DE COMBINAR COM A NOSSA FORCA.

items.english: WE HAVE TRICKED THE GAZURTOID INTO TELLING US MANY THINGS.  WE HAPPEN TO KNOW ALL ABOUT THE UHLEK.  NOT MANY RACES KNOW ABOUT THE UHLEK, BUT OF COURSE NO OTHER RACE HAS THE AWESOME MIND OF A SPEMIN.
items.portuguese: ENGANAREMOS O GAZURTOID PARA NOS DIZER MUITAS COISAS.  ACONTECEMOS SABER TUDO SOBRE O UHLEK.  POUCAS RACAS SABEM SOBRE O UHLEK, MAS E CLARO QUE NENHUMA OUTRA RACA TEM A MENTE INCRIVEL DE UM SPEMIN.

items.english: THE UHLEK ARE NOT MANY CREATURES, BUT ONE.  IT IS SIMPLY SPREAD OUT IN SPACE.  THE UHLEK HAVE A CENTRAL MIND-GANGLION.  IT IS A MASSIVE THING BURIED DEEP WITHIN A PLANET.  IF IT WAS DESTROYED THE UHLEK WOULD BE HELPLESS UNTIL ANOTHER ONE DEVELOPED.
items.portuguese: OS UHLEK NAO SAO MUITAS CRIATURAS, MAS UMA.  ESTA SIMPLESMENTE ESPALHADO NO ESPACO.  OS UHLEK TEM UM GANGLIO MENTAL CENTRAL.  E UMA COISA ENORME ENTERRADA NAS PROFUNDIDADES DE UM PLANETA.  SE FOSSE DESTRUIDO, O UHLEK FICARIA INDEFESO ATE QUE OUTRO SE DESENVOLVESSE.

items.english: TO DESTROY AN UHLEK MIND-GANGLION IT IS NECESSARY TO DESTROY AN ENTIRE PLANET.  OF COURSE WE COULD DESTROY AN ENTIRE PLANET IF WE CHOSE TO.  UNFORTUNATELY WE HAVE A LAW AGAINST DESTROYING PLANETS, SO SOME OTHER FEARLESS, POWERFUL RACE SHALL HAVE TO DO IT.
items.portuguese: PARA DESTRUIR UM GANGLIO MENTE UHLEK E NECESSARIO DESTRUIR UM PLANETA INTEIRO.  E CLARO QUE PODEMOS DESTRUIR UM PLANETA INTEIRO SE DECOLHERMOS.  INFELIZMENTE TEMOS UMA LEI CONTRA A DESTRUICAO DE PLANETAS, ENTAO ALGUMA OUTRA RACA PODEROSA E DESTEMIDA TERA QUE FAZER ISSO.

items.english: THE MIND-GANGLION PLANET OF THE UHLEK IS THE LIFE-BEARING PLANET IN THE SYSTEM 55,32.  DESTROYING IT SHOULD BE A TRIVIAL TASK.  WE ARE ALMOST TEMPTED TO DO IT OURSELVES.
items.portuguese: O PLANETA GANGLIO MENTAL DO UHLEK E O PLANETA QUE PORTA VIDA NO SISTEMA 55,32.  DESTRUI-LO DEVE SER UMA TAREFA TRIVIAL.  SOMOS QUASE TENTADOS A FAZER ISSO NOS MESMOS.

items.english: DO NOT PLAY GAMES WITH US.  IF YOU WISH TO KNOW ABOUT OUR GREAT SPEMIN RACE JUST ASK.
items.portuguese: NAO JOGUE CONOSCO.  SE VOCE DESEJA SABER SOBRE NOSSA GRANDE CORRIDA DE SPEMIN, BASTA PERGUNTAR.

items.english: YOU REQUIRE INFORMATION?  HERE IS SOME INFORMATION.  YOU WILL DIE VERY SOON.  PLEASE LET US KNOW IF YOU NEED MORE INFORMATION.
items.portuguese: VOCE PRECISA DE INFORMACOES?  AQUI ESTAO ALGUMAS INFORMACOES.  VOCE VAI MORRER MUITO EM BREVE.  POR FAVOR, INFORME-NOS SE PRECISAR DE MAIS INFORMACOES.

items.english: THERE IS A SECRET WAY INTO UHLEK TERRITORY.  THE FIRST JUMP POINT IS AT 106,139.  THE SECOND IS AT 64,186.  AND THE THIRD IS AT 35,186.  DO NOT TRY TO DO THIS THOUGH.  ANYONE BUT A MASTER SPEMIN NAVIGATOR WOULD GET LOST.
items.portuguese: HA UM CAMINHO SECRETO PARA O TERRITORIO UHLEK.  O PRIMEIRO PONTO DE SALTO ESTA EM 106.139.  O SEGUNDO ESTA EM 64.186.  E O TERCEIRO ESTA EM 35.186.  NAO TENTE FAZER ISSO.  QUALQUER PESSOA, A NAO SER UM NAVEGADOR MESTRE SPEMIN, SE PERDIRIA.

items.english: ALRIGHT......YOU HAVE FORCED IT OUT OF US.  WE HAVE HEARD OF THE EXISTENCE OF A VELOXI FOCUSING STONE ON THE FIRST PLANET OF THE SYSTEM 81,98.  WE HAVE BEEN UNABLE TO....I MEAN HAVE CHOSEN NOT TO FIND IT THOUGH.
items.portuguese: CERTO... VOCE FORCOU ISSO DE NOS.  OUVIMOS FALAR DA EXISTENCIA DE UMA PEDRA DE FOCO VELOXI NO PRIMEIRO PLANETA DO SISTEMA 81,98.  NAO FOMOS CAPAZES DE... SIGNIFICA, ESCOLHEI NAO ENCONTRAR.

items.english: WE SPEMIN ARE WISE BEYOND IMAGINING.  FOR EXAMPLE, WE HAPPEN TO KNOW THAT THE ANCIENTS BUILT A DEVICE CALLED A CRYSTAL PEARL WHICH AUTOMATICALLY WARPS A CRITICALLY WOUNDED SHIP OUT OF DANGER.  THIS IS JUST ONE OF MANY THINGS WE KNOW.
items.portuguese: NOS SPEMIN SOMOS MAIS SABIOS ALEM DA IMAGINACAO.  POR EXEMPLO, ACONTECEMOS SABER QUE OS ANTIGOS CONSTRUIRAM UM DISPOSITIVO CHAMADO PEROLA DE CRISTAL QUE DEIXA AUTOMATICAMENTE UMA NAVE CRITICAMENTE FERIDA, FORA DO PERIGO.  ESTA E APENAS UMA DAS MUITAS COISAS QUE SABEMOS.

items.english: THE OLD EMPIRE IS OF NO IMPORTANCE.  OBVIOUSLY WHAT YOU WISH TO KNOW ABOUT IS OUR RACE.  SUCH FOOLS.  YOU THOUGHT TO HIDE THIS FROM US.
items.portuguese: O VELHO IMPERIO NAO TEM IMPORTANCIA.  OBVIAMENTE O QUE VOCE DESEJA SABER E A NOSSA RACA.  TAIS TOLOS.  VOCE PENSOU ESCONDER ISSO DE NOS.

items.english: WE DESTROYED THE OLD EMPIRE BECAUSE THEY DID NOT OBEY OUR COMMANDS.  THERE IS A LESSON HERE FOR YOU TO LEARN.
items.portuguese: DESTRUIMOS O VELHO IMPERIO PORQUE ELES NAO OBEDECERAM NOSSOS COMANDOS.  HA UMA LICAO AQUI PARA VOCE APRENDER.

items.english: WE WERE ONCE A PART OF THE OLD EMPIRE, AS WERE THE VELOX, THE THRYNN, AND THE ELOWAN.  YOUR KIND HAS UNJUSTLY FORSAKEN US, WE WHO HAVE NOTHING BUT RESPECT AND ADMIRATION AND YES, EVEN LOVE FOR YOUR PEOPLE.  FOR SHAME.
items.portuguese: JA FIZEMOS PARTE DO ANTIGO IMPERIO, ASSIM COMO O VELOX, O THRYNN E O ELOWAN.  SUA GENTE NOS ABANDONOU IJUSTAMENTE, NOS QUE NADA TEMOS ALEM DE RESPEITO E ADMIRACAO E SIM, ATE AMOR PELO SEU POVO.  POR VERGONHA.

items.english: THE ANCIENT ONES WORSHIPPED US AS DO ALL THE OTHER RACES.  PERHAPS YOU WOULD LIKE TO KNOW MORE ABOUT OUR RACE.
items.portuguese: OS ANTIGOS NOS ADORAM COMO TODAS AS OUTRAS RACAS.  TALVEZ VOCE GOSTE DE SABER MAIS SOBRE NOSSA RACA.

items.english: WHO ARE YOU TO DEMAND INFORMATION FROM US?  THE ANCIENT ONES WERE NOTHING COMPARED TO THE SPEMIN, JUST AS YOU ARE NOTHING.
items.portuguese: QUEM E VOCE PARA EXIGIR INFORMACOES DE NOS?  OS ANTIGOS NAO FORAM NADA COMPARADOS COM OS SPEMIN, ASSIM COMO VOCE NAO E NADA.

items.english: THERE ARE MANY RUINS OF THE ANCIENTS IN SPEMIN TERRITORY.  IN FACT, THERE IS A GREAT CITY OF THE ANCIENTS IN A NEBULA JUST OUTWARD OF OUR HOME PLANET.  OF COURSE, THE LOCATION OF OUR HOME PLANET IS SECRET, AND ANY SPEMIN WOULD DIE BEFORE HE WOULD REVEAL IT.
items.portuguese: HA MUITAS RUINAS DOS ANTIGOS NO TERRITORIO DE SPEMIN.  DE FATO, HA UMA GRANDE CIDADE DE ANTIGOS EM UMA NEBULA LOGO FORA DE NOSSO PLANETA LAR.  E CLARO QUE A LOCALIZACAO DO NOSSO PLANETA LAR E SECRETA, E QUALQUER SPEMIN MORRERIA ANTES DE REVELA-LO.

items.english: IT IS FORTUNATE THAT YOU RECOGNIZE THE VAST SUPERIORITY OF YOUR SPEMIN MASTERS.  THAT IS TO SAY, US.  WE SHALL SPARE YOU THIS TIME.  PERHAPS.
items.portuguese: E UMA SORTE QUE VOCE RECONHECA A VASTA SUPERIORIDADE DE SEUS MESTRES SPEMIN.  QUER DIZER, NOS.  VAMOS POUPAR VOCE DESTA VEZ.  TALVEZ.

items.english: SO, YOU WISH TO PRAISE US.  THIS IS ACCEPTABLE.  YOU MAY CONTINUE TO DO SO.
items.portuguese: ENTAO, VOCE DESEJA NOS ELOGIAR.  ISSO E ACEITAVEL.  VOCE PODE CONTINUAR A FAZER ISSO.

items.english: IN THE YEAR 3000, WHEN THE NUMLOX AND PHLEGMAK ATTACKED THE EMPIRE, THE SPEMIN BEGGED FOR PROTECTION.  DESPITE THEIR DECLARATION OF WAR IN 2790 PROTECTION WAS GRANTED.  AT THE END OF THE ATTACK THE SPEMIN AGAIN TURNED ON THE EMPIRE.
items.portuguese: NO ANO 3000, QUANDO O NUMLOX E O PHLEGMAK ATACARAM O IMPERIO, O SPEMIN IMPLOROU POR PROTECAO.  APESAR DE SUA DECLARACAO DE GUERRA EM 2790, A PROTECAO FOI CONCEDIDA.  NO FINAL DO ATAQUE, O SPEMIN NOVAMENTE LIGOU O IMPERIO.

items.english: IN THE YEAR 3400 THE SECOND WAVE ATTACKED THE EMPIRE.  FOR THE SECOND TIME THE SPEMIN PLEADED FOR PROTECTION.  WHEN THE EMPIRE DID NOT GRANT IT THE SPEMIN ALLIED WITH THE GAZURTOID.
items.portuguese: NO ANO 3400 A SEGUNDA ONDA ATACOU O IMPERIO.  PELA SEGUNDA VEZ, O SPEMIN PEDIU PROTECAO.  QUANDO O IMPERIO NAO O CONCEDE O SPEMIN ALIADO AO GAZURTOID.

items.english: THE SPEMIN\S TECHNOLOGY IS INFERIOR SINCE THEY ONLY COPY FROM OTHER RACES.  IN SPITE OF THIS THEY ARE NUMEROUS BECAUSE THEY BUILD THEIR SHIPS OUT OF CHEAP MATERIALS AND REPRODUCE AT AN ASTONISHING RATE.
items.portuguese: A TECNOLOGIA DO SPEMIN E INFERIOR, POIS SO COPIAM DE OUTRAS RACAS.  APESAR DISSO, SAO NUMEROSOS PORQUE CONSTRUEM SUAS NAVES COM MATERIAIS BARATOS E SE REPRODUZEM A UMA TAXA SURPREENDENTE.

items.english: IN THE YEAR 4410 WE HAD AN ENCOUNTER WITH A SPEMIN SHIP.  IT THREATENED US AND THEN FLED.
items.portuguese: NO ANO 4410 TIVEMOS UM ENCONTRO COM UMA NAVE SPEMIN.  NOS AMEACOU E DEPOIS FUGIU.

items.english: THE VELOX WERE THE FIRST RACE ENCOUNTERED BY THE EMPIRE.  THIS WAS IN 2300.
items.portuguese: OS VELOX FORAM A PRIMEIRA RACA ENCONTRADA PELO IMPERIO.  ISSO FOI EM 2300.

items.english: THERE WERE MINOR SKIRMISHES WITH THE VELOX BETWEEN 2300 AND 2400 UNTIL THE HUMAN-VELOX TREATY WAS FINALLY SIGNED.
items.portuguese: HOUVE PEQUENAS ESCARMACAS COM O VELOX ENTRE 2300 E 2400 ATE QUE O TRATADO HUMAN-VELOX FOI FINALMENTE ASSINADO.

items.english: THE VELOX HAVE BEEN IN SPACE FOR MANY THOUSANDS OF YEARS.  MUCH OF THE EMPIRE\S TECHNOLOGY, INCLUDING SHIP DESIGN, WAS MODELED AFTER THEIRS.
items.portuguese: OS VELOX ESTAO NO ESPACO HA MUITOS MILHARES DE ANOS.  GRANDE PARTE DA TECNOLOGIA DO IMPERIO, INCLUINDO O DESIGN DA NAVE, FOI MODELADA APOS A DELES.

items.english: THE VELOX EMPIRE IS UPSPIN OF HERE.  THEY ARE ARROGANT AND SINCE 3330 HAVE HAD AN ISOLATIONIST ATTITUDE.
items.portuguese: O IMPERIO VELOX ESTA AQUI.  SAO ARROGANTES E DESDE 3330 TEM UMA ATITUDE ISOLACIONISTA.

items.english: THE THRYNN ARE SENTIENT REPTILIAN CREATURES THAT WERE DISCOVERED AND TAKEN INTO THE EMPIRE IN 2770.  THEY ARE NATIVES OF THE SAME SYSTEM AS THE ELOWAN.
items.portuguese: OS THRYNN SAO CRIATURAS REPTILIANAS SENTIENTES QUE FORAM DESCOBERTAS E LEVADAS PARA O IMPERIO EM 2770. SAO NATIVOS DO MESMO SISTEMA DOS ELOWAN.

items.english: THE ELOWAN ARE PLANT-LIKE CREATURES WHICH WERE AT FIRST BELIEVED TO NOT BE SENTIENT, DUE TO THE DEPRECATIONS OF THEIR ENEMIES, THE THRYNN.
items.portuguese: OS ELOWAN SAO CRIATURAS PLANTAS QUE A PRIMEIRO TEMPO ACREDITARAM NAO SER SENTIENTES, DEVIDO AS DEPRECACOES DE SEUS INIMIGOS, OS THRYNN.

items.english: THE THRYNN CONCERN THEMSELVES ONLY WITH \MATTERS OF IMPORT.\  IN THE EMPIRE THEY GENERALLY FILLED THE NICHES OF AMBASSADORS, DIPLOMATS AND SPIES.
items.portuguese: OS THRYNN PREOCUPAM-SE APENAS COM ASSUNTOS DE IMPORTACAO. NO IMPERIO ELES GERALMENTE PREENCHEM OS NICHOS DE EMBAIXADORES, DIPLOMATAS E ESPIOES.

items.english: THE ELOWAN HAVE A REPUTATION AS CREATIVE THINKERS.  IN THE EMPIRE THEY WERE GENERALLY ARTISTS, PHILOSOPHERS, AND THEORETICAL SCIENTISTS.
items.portuguese: OS ELOWAN TEM REPUTACAO DE PENSADORES CRIATIVOS.  NO IMPERIO ERAM GERALMENTE ARTISTAS, FILOSOFOS E CIENTISTAS TEORICOS.

items.english: THE THRYNN AND ELOWAN WERE DISCOVERED ON DIFFERENT PLANETS IN A K CLASS SYSTEM WITH 5 PLANETS DOWNSPIN OF HERE.  THE THRYNN HAD A MORE ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY AND OFTEN ATTACKED THE ELOWAN PLANET.
items.portuguese: THRYNN E ELOWAN FORAM DESCOBERTOS EM DIFERENTES PLANETAS EM UM SISTEMA DE CLASSE K COM 5 PLANETAS ABAIXO AQUI.  O THRYNN TINHA UMA TECNOLOGIA MAIS AVANCADA E FREQUENTEMENTE ATACOU O PLANETA ELOWAN.

items.english: WE GIVE WARNING. YOU MUST LEAVE.
items.portuguese: DAMOS AVISO. VOCE DEVE SAIR.

items.english: CEASE COMMUNICATIONS AND LEAVE IMMEDIATELY.
items.portuguese: CESSAR AS COMUNICACOES E SAIR IMEDIATAMENTE.

items.english: THE INSTITUTE WAS A SOCIETY OF SCIENTISTS AND OTHER INTELLECTUALS CONVINCED OF THE EMPIRE\S IMPENDING DESTRUCTION.
items.portuguese: O INSTITUTO ERA UMA SOCIEDADE DE CIENTISTAS E OUTROS INTELECTUAIS CONVENCIDOS DA DESTRUICAO IMINENTE DO IMPERIO.

items.english: THE INSTITUTE DISCOVERED AN INCREASE IN THE INSTABILITY OF STARS COREWARD.  THERE ARE MANY REFERENCES IN OUR DATA BANKS TO THE ENCROACHING  \DEAD ZONE.\
items.portuguese: O INSTITUTO DESCOBREU UM AUMENTO NA INSTABILIDADE DO STARS COREWARD.  HA MUITAS REFERENCIAS EM NOSSOS BANCOS DE DADOS A \ZONA MORTA.

items.english: WHEN WE LEFT EARTH THE INSTITUTE WAS STUDYING SOL FOR ANOMALOUS RADIATION EMISSIONS.
items.portuguese: QUANDO DEIXAMOS A TERRA, O INSTITUTO ESTAVA ESTUDANDO O SOL PARA EMISSOES DE RADIACAO ANOMALAS.

items.english: SOL IS OF COURSE IN THE PYTHAGORAS CONSTELLATION. EARTH DID MOST OF ITS MINING ON MINERAL-RICH MARDAN-4, ALSO IN PYTHAGORAS.
items.portuguese: SOL ESTA NA CONSTELACAO DE PITAGORAS. A TERRA FEZ A MAIORIA DE SUA MINERACAO NO RICO MARDAN-4, TAMBEM EM PITAGORAS.

items.english: THE INSTITUTE HAS A STARFLIGHT RESEARCH STATION AT THE CENTER OF THE NORTH POLE ON MARS.
items.portuguese: O INSTITUTO TEM UMA ESTACAO DE PESQUISA STARFLIGHT NO CENTRO DO POLO NORTE EM MARTE.

items.english: THE FIRST NOAH MISSION, NOAH 1, FAILED BECAUSE A RING DEVICE MALFUNCTION RESULTED IN AN INABILITY TO IDENTIFY CONTINUUM FLUXES.
items.portuguese: A PRIMEIRA MISSAO DE NOAH, NOAH 1, FALHA PORQUE UM MAU FUNCIONAMENTO DO DISPOSITIVO DE ANEL RESULTARA NA INCAPACIDADE DE IDENTIFICAR FLUXOS CONTINUOS.

items.english: WE HAVE FOUND EVIDENCE OF EMPIRE RUINS AT 28N X 4E ON ONE OF THE PLANETS IN THE NEARBY CLASS-G SYSTEM.  WE HAVE BEEN UNABLE TO INVESTIGATE HOWEVER BECAUSE IT IS WITHIN VELOXI SPACE AND IS GUARDED BY A DRONE.
items.portuguese: ENCONTRAMOS EVIDENCIAS DE RUINAS DO IMPERIO EM 28N X 4E EM UM DOS PLANETAS DO SISTEMA CLASSE-G PROXIMO.  NAO PODEMOS INVESTIGAR PORQUE ESTA DENTRO DO ESPACO VELOXI E E GUARDADO POR UM DRONE.

items.english: THIS IS THE FINAL WARNING.
items.portuguese: ESTE E O AVISO FINAL.

items.english: THE FIRST WAVE OF ATTACKS ON THE EMPIRE WAS BY THE NUMLOX AND PHLEGMAK AND STARTED IN 3000.  THE SECOND WAVE, COMPRISED OF UHLEK AND GAZURTOID, STARTED IN 3400.  BOTH CAME FROM COREWARD.
items.portuguese: A PRIMEIRA ONDA DE ATAQUES AO IMPERIO FOI PELO NUMLOX E PHLEGMAK E COMECOU EM 3000. A SEGUNDA ONDA, COMPOSTA POR UHLEK E ??GAZURTOID, COMECOU EM 3400. AMBAS VEIO DO COREWARD.

items.english: AS OF THE TIME OF OUR DEPARTURE THERE WAS AN 84 PERCENT CERTAINTY FACTOR THAT THE NUMLOX AND PHLEGMAK RACES HAD BEEN COMPLETELY DESTROYED BY THE EMPIRE.
items.portuguese: NO MOMENTO DE NOSSA PARTIDA, HAVIA UM FATOR DE CERTEZA DE 84 POR CENTO DE QUE AS RACAS NUMLOX E PHLEGMAK FORAM COMPLETAMENTE DESTRUIDAS PELO IMPERIO.

items.english: YOUR PRESENCE HERE INDICATES THE EMPIRE HAS SURVIVED. AT THE TIME OF OUR DEPARTURE THE PROBABILITY OF THIS WAS VERY LOW.
items.portuguese: SUA PRESENCA AQUI INDICA QUE O IMPERIO SOBREVIVEU. NO MOMENTO DA NOSSA PARTIDA A PROBABILIDADE DE ISSO ERA MUITO BAIXA.

items.english: DURING THE WARS WITH THE PHLEGMAK MANY WORLDS OF THE EMPIRE WERE DESTROYED BY THEIR BLACK-EGG PLANET BOMBS.
items.portuguese: DURANTE AS GUERRAS COM O PHLEGMAK, MUITOS MUNDOS DO IMPERIO FORAM DESTRUIDOS POR SUAS BOMBAS DO PLANETA OVO NEGRO.

items.english: THE ENTIRE ECONOMY OF THE EMPIRE IS BASED ON ENDURIUM. WHEN WE LEFT, THE RICHEST AND STRONGEST PLANET WAS NEW SCOTLAND,THE SECOND PLANET IN THE UPSPIN END OF THE STAFF CONSTELLATION.
items.portuguese: TODA A ECONOMIA DO IMPERIO E BASEADA NO ENDURIUM. QUANDO PARTIMOS, O PLANETA MAIS RICO E FORTE ERA A NOVA ESCOCIA, O SEGUNDO PLANETA NA PONTA ALTA DA CONSTELACAO DE PESSOAL.

items.english: WHEN WE LEFT, THE EMPIRE WAS DIVIDED INTO MANY FACTIONS.  ONE OF THESE WAS HEADED BY LAYTON. THE LAYTONITES BELIEVED THE EMPIRE WAS EVIL AND SHOULD DIE.  THEY ARE ENEMIES OF PROJECT NOAH.  THEY ARE OUR ENEMIES.
items.portuguese: QUANDO SAIMOS, O IMPERIO FOI DIVIDIDO EM MUITAS FACCOES.  UM DESSES FOI LIDERADO POR LAYTON. OS LAYTONITES ACREDITARAM QUE O IMPERIO ERA MAL E DEVERIA MORRER.  SAO INIMIGOS DO PROJETO NOAH.  SAO NOSSOS INIMIGOS.

items.english: EMPIRE MORALE WAS BROKEN IN 3440 WHEN THE OFFENSIVE HEADQUARTERS ON MARDAN-2 WERE DESTROYED BY THE UHLEK.
items.portuguese: O MORAL DO IMPERIO FOI QUEBRADO EM 3440, QUANDO A SEDE OFENSIVA EM MARDAN-2 FOI DESTRUIDA PELO UHLEK.

items.english: THE INSTITUTE HAS AN UNDERGROUND STATION ON EARTH AT 12N X 104W.
items.portuguese: O INSTITUTO TEM UMA ESTACAO SUBTERRANEA NA TERRA A 12N X 104W.

items.english: THE EMPIRE UTILIZES DRONES CALLED NOMADS IN THEIR PRELIMINARY EXPLORATIONS.  THESE COLLECT LIFE AND MINERAL DATA ON PLANETS WHICH MAY PROVE TO BE SUITABLE FOR COLONIZATION.
items.portuguese: O IMPERIO UTILIZA DRONES CHAMADOS NOMADAS EM SUAS EXPLORACOES PRELIMINARES.  ESTES COLETAM DADOS DE VIDA E MINERAIS EM PLANETAS QUE PODEM SER ADEQUADOS PARA COLONIZACAO.

items.english: YOU WILL BE DESTROYED.
items.portuguese: VOCE SERA DESTRUIDO.

items.english: ENDURIUM WAS FIRST DISCOVERED IN SOME ANCIENT RUINS ON SOL-4 IN 2100.
items.portuguese: ENDURIUM FOI DESCOBERTO PELA PRIMEIRA VEZ EM ALGUMAS RUINAS ANTIGAS NO SOL-4 EM 2100.

items.english: THE STRANGE CRYSTALLINE LUMPS OF ENDURIUM ARE ALWAYS FOUND IN ANCIENT RUINS.
items.portuguese: OS ESTRANHOS PEDACOS CRISTALINOS DE ENDURIUM SAO SEMPRE ENCONTRADOS EM RUINAS ANTIGAS.

items.english: RUINS OF THE ANCIENTS HAVE BEEN FOUND ALL OVER SPACE, BUT PRIMARILY SEEM TO BE IN M-TYPE SYSTEMS.  THEY ARE MANY HUNDREDS OF MILLIONS OF YEARS OLD.
items.portuguese: RUINAS DOS ANTIGOS FORAM ENCONTRADAS POR TODO O ESPACO, MAS PRIMEIRAMENTE PARECEM ESTAR EM SISTEMAS DO TIPO M.  TEM MUITAS CENTENAS DE MILHOES DE ANOS.

items.english: THE INSTITUTE, BASED AT 75S X 66E ON AKTERON 6 STUDIED THE ANCIENTS INTENSELY.  THERE WAS MUCH CONTROVERSY SURROUNDING THEIR FINDINGS.  THEY OFTEN WORKED WITH THE ELOWAN.
items.portuguese: O INSTITUTO, BASEADO EM 75S X 66E EM AKTERON 6 ESTUDOU INTENSAMENTE OS ANTIGOS.  HOUVE MUITA CONTROVERSIA EM TORNO DE SUAS DESCOBERTAS.  ELES TRABALHARAM COM FREQUENCIA COM O ELOWAN.

items.english: IN THE EMPIRE THERE WERE SEVERAL POPULAR THEORIES ABOUT THE ANCIENTS.  ONE WAS THAT THEY TRAVELLED THE UNIVERSE SEEDING LIFE AND LEAVING ENDURIUM.  ANOTHER BELIEF IS THAT THEY WILL ONE DAY RETURN TO JUDGE MANKIND.
items.portuguese: NO IMPERIO EXISTEM VARIAS TEORIAS POPULARES SOBRE OS ANTIGOS.  UMA FOI QUE VIAJARAM PELO UNIVERSO SEMEANDO VIDA E DEIXANDO ENDURIUM.  OUTRA CRENCA E QUE UM DIA VOLTARAO PARA JULGAR A HUMANIDADE.

items.english: IT IS BELIEVED THAT THE DEVICE KNOWN AS THE CRYSTAL PLANET WAS BUILT BY THE ANCIENTS.
items.portuguese: ACREDITA-SE QUE O DISPOSITIVO CONHECIDO COMO PLANETA CRISTAL FOI CONSTRUIDO PELOS ANTIGOS.

items.english: THERE HAVE LONG BEEN RUMORS THAT SOMEWHERE IN A NEBULA IN SPEMIN SPACE IS A VAST CITY OF THE ANCIENTS. IT IS THOUGHT TO BE ON THE INNERMOST PLANET OF THE SYSTEM.
items.portuguese: HA MUITO RUMORES DE QUE EM ALGUM LUGAR DE UMA NEBULA NO ESPACO SPEMIN HA UMA VASTA CIDADE DOS ANTIGOS. PENSA-SE QUE ESTEJA NO PLANETA MAIS INTERNO DO SISTEMA.

items.portuguese: DESCOBRIMOS ALGUMAS RUINAS EM 36N X 90E NO PLANETA DE GELO EM NOSSO SISTEMA.

items.english: 02-01-4620  UNPLEASANT NEWSr   IT IS NECESSARY TO GIVE YOU SOME UNPLEASANT NEWS.  YOU MAY HAVE BEEN AWARE THAT FOR THE LAST SEVERAL YEARS SCIENTISTS HAVE BEEN OBSERVING ANOMALOUS FLUCTUATIONS IN THE RADIATION LEVELS OF OUR SUN.r   WHILE YOU HAVE BEEN AWAY IT HAS BEEN ASCERTAINED THAT THE STABILITY OF OUR SUN IS DEFINITELY DETERIORATING.  HOW MUCH TIME WE HAVE UNTIL THERE IS A FATALLY LARGE FLARE, WE ARE STILL NOT SURE, BUT THERE IS LITTLE DOUBT THAT THIS WILL EVENTUALLY OCCUR.r   AS YET, WE HAVE NO CLUE AS TO THE CAUSE OF THIS INSTABILITY.  THEREFORE, WE MUST ASSUME THAT THERE IS NOTHING WE CAN DO TO CHANGE THE SITUATION.  IN VIEW OF THIS THE ONLY OPTION AVAILABLE TO US IS TO GET AS MANY COLONISTS OFF OF ARTH AS WE CAN.r   YOU CAN BE INVALUABLE TO US IN THIS.  FIRST WE NEED ENDURIUM TO POWER THE SHIPS WE WILL BUILD.  WE WILL PAY WELL FOR ANY THAT YOU CAN BRING BACK.  SECONDLY, WE NEED TO KNOW WHERE TO SEND THE COLONISTS.r   AS YOU MAY HAVE ALREADY DISCOVERED, YOUR SHIP IS EQUIPPED WITH HOMING DRONES WHICH YOU MAY USE TO LOG YOUR RECOMMENDATIONS.  THIS IS SO THAT WE CAN MOVE THE COLONISTS OUT AS QUICKLY AS POSSIBLE.r   IN ADDITION, A SENSOR HAS BEEN INSTALLED WHICH WILL INFORM YOU OF THE STELLAR CONDITION UPON ENTERING A SYSTEM.  YOUR SHIP COMPUTER WILL INFORM YOU IN THE EVENT THAT A FLARE IS IMMINENT.r   WE ADVISE CAUTION WHILE IN SYSTEMS WHICH ARE MORE THAN SLIGHTLY UNSTABLE. BEING CAUGHT IN A SOLAR FLARE WOULD CERTAINLY BE FATAL.r   IN YOUR MANUAL WE HAVE OUTLINED THE CRITERIA WHICH WILL BE IMPORTANT IN YOUR EVALUATION OF VIABLE COLONY WORLDS.  YOU WILL BE REWARDED FOR RECOMMENDATIONS OF VALUABLE PLANETS AND PENALIZED FOR RECOMMENDATIONS OF PLANETS WHICH TURN OUT TO BE UNINHABITABLE.r   CONSIDER CAREFULLY BEFORE LOGGING A PLANET.r

PORTANTO, DEVEMOS ASSUMIR QUE NAO HA NADA QUE PODEMOS FAZER PARA MUDAR A SITUACAO. PRIMEIRO PRECISAMOS DE ENDURIO PARA ALIMENTAR AS NAVES QUE CONSTRUIREMOS.  PAGAMOS BEM POR QUALQUER QUE VOCE POSSA TRAZER DE VOLTA.  SEGUNDO, PRECISAMOS SABER PARA ONDE ENVIAR OS COLONISTAS.r   COMO VOCE JA DEVE TER DESCOBERTO, SUA NAVE ESTA EQUIPADA COM DRONES DE RETORNO QUE VOCE PODE USAR PARA REGISTRAR SUAS RECOMENDACOES. O COMPUTADOR DA SUA NAVE INFORMA-LO-A NO CASO DE UM FLARE SER IMINENTE.r   ACONSELHAMOS CUIDADO EM SISTEMAS QUE SAO MAIS DO QUE LEVEMENTE INSTAVEIS. items.english: LOG ENTRY, 8-8-3382, COMMANDER MCCONNELL, ENTRY 1 - I HAVE SUCCESSFULLY TELEPORTED TO THE CRYSTAL PLANET!  I AM DIZZY AND HAVE EXPERIENCED A PROFOUND SENSE OF DISORIENTAION BUT OTHER THAN THAT I SEEM TO BE FINE.  THE CONTROL NEXUS IS VISIBLE FROM HERE.    ENTRY 2 - IT WOULD SEEM THAT THE ELECTROMAGNETIC FIELD AROUND THE CRYSTAL PLANET IS, IN FACT, BLOCKING COMMUNICATIONS SINCE IT HAS BEEN AN HOUR AND I HAVE STILL RECEIVED NO TRANSMISSION FROM CRYSTAL BASE 1.    ENTRY 2 CONT. - I AM THEREFORE WRITING IN THIS LOG AS PLANNED, AND WILL ATTEMPT TO FIND A SAFE PLACE FOR IT BEFORE THE EXPLOSION.    ENTRY 3 - I HAVE REACHED THE CONTROL CENTER AND HAVE SET THE CHARGES.  IT APPEARS TO BE A MASSIVE RUIN OF THE ANCIENTS.  THE QUEER CRYSTALLINE LUMPS OF ENDURIUM ARE EVERYWHERE HERE.    ENTRY 4 - I HAVE JUST HAD AN ASTOUNDING EXPERIENCE!  I CAN HARDLY BELIEVE IT BUT I SEEM TO HAVE MADE TELEPATHIC CONTACT WITH THE ANCIENTS.  THEY ARE HERE!  ON THE CRYSTAL PLANET, CONTROLLING IT!    ENTRY 4 CONT. - I WISH THERE WAS SOME WAY FOR ME TO COMMUNICATE WHAT I HAVE FOUND.  THE EXPLOSION IS SET FOR T-MINUS 40 MINUTES.  IN THE EVENT THAT THE CRYSTAL PLANET IS NOT DESTROYED, I CAN ONLY HOPE THAT THIS LOG IS FOUND BY SOMEONE.    ENTRY 4 CONT.- I CAN HARDLY BELIEVE IT!  THOSE WEIRD LUMPS ARE ACTUALLY INTELLIGENT LIFE.  THE ANCIENTS ARE ENDURIUM! AND WE HAVE SPENT HUNDREDS OF YEARS HUNTING THEM TO BURN FOR FUEL IN OUR SHIPS.    ENTRY 4 CONT.- THEIR METABOLISM IS SO MUCH SLOWER THAN OURS THEY LIVE IN AN ENTIRELY DIFFERENT TIME FRAMEWORK.  I DON\T THINK THEY EVEN KNOW WE ARE SENTIENT.  I BELIEVE IT WAS ONLY BECAUSE OF A LINK THROUGH THE CRYSTAL PLANET THAT CONTACT WAS MADE AT ALL.    ENTRY 4 CONT.- THIS CRYSTAL PLANET WAS THEIR LAST DEFENSE.  I CAN HARDLY BLAME THEM.  CARBON-BASED LIFE MUST HAVE SEEMED SOMETHING LIKE A VIRUS TO THEM.  JUST THE SAME, I HOPE THE EXPLOSION WORKS.  IT LOOKS LIKE AT THIS POINT LIKE IT\S US OR THEM.  MCCONNELL OUT.
items.portuguese: DIARIO DE BORDO, 8-8-3382, COMANDANTE MCCONNELL, ENTRADA 1 - TELEPORTEI-ME COM SUCESSO PARA O PLANETA CRISTAL!  ESTOU TONTO E EXPERIMENTEI UM PROFUNDO SENTIMENTO DE DESORRIENTACAO, MAS, FORA ISSO, PARECE ESTAR BEM.  O NEXUS DE CONTROLE E VISIVEL AQUI.    ENTRADA 2 - PARECE QUE O CAMPO ELETROMAGNETICO AO REDOR DO PLANETA CRISTAL ESTA, DE FATO, BLOQUEANDO AS COMUNICACOES DESDE QUE JA SE PASSOU UMA HORA E AINDA NAO RECEBI NENHUMA TRANSMISSAO DA BASE CRISTAL 1. ENTRADA 2 CONT. - PORTANTO ESTOU ESCREVENDO NESTE REGISTRO COMO PLANEJADO, E TENTAREI ENCONTRAR UM LUGAR SEGURO PARA ELE ANTES DA EXPLOSAO.    ENTRADA 3 - CHEGUEI AO CENTRO DE CONTROLE E AJUSTEI AS TAXAS.  PARECE SER UMA RUINA ENORME DOS ANTIGOS.  OS QUEER PEDACOS CRISTALINOS DE ENDURIUM ESTAO POR TODA PARTE AQUI.    ACESSO 4 - ACABEI DE TER UMA EXPERIENCIA INCRIVEL!  MAL POSSO ACREDITAR, MAS PARECE QUE FIZ CONTATO TELEPATICO COM OS ANTIGOS.  ELES ESTAO AQUI!  NO PLANETA CRISTAL, CONTROLANDO-O!    ENTRADA 4 CONT. - DESEJO QUE HAJA ALGUMA FORMA DE COMUNICAR O QUE ENCONTREI.  A EXPLOSAO ESTA PROGRAMADA PARA T-MENOS 40 MINUTOS.  CASO O PLANETA CRISTAL NAO SEJA DESTRUIDO, SO POSSO ESPERAR QUE ESTE REGISTRO SEJA ENCONTRADO POR ALGUEM.    ACESSO 4 CONT.- MAL ACREDITO!  ESSES NODULOS ESTRANHOS SAO REALMENTE VIDA INTELIGENTE.  OS ANTIGOS SAO ENDURIO! E PASSAMOS CENTENAS DE ANOS CACANDO-OS PARA QUEIMAREM COMBUSTIVEL EM NOSSAS NAVES.    ENTRADA 4 CONT.- SEU METABOLISMO E MUITO MAIS LENTO QUE O NOSSOS, ELES VIVEM EM UM TEMPO TOTALMENTE DIFERENTE.  ACHO QUE ELES NAO SABEM QUE SOMOS SENTIENTES.  ACREDITO QUE FOI SO POR CAUSA DE UMA LIGACAO ATRAVES DO PLANETA CRISTAL QUE O CONTATO FOI FEITO.    ACESSO 4 CONT.- ESTE PLANETA DE CRISTAL FOI SUA ULTIMA DEFESA.  NAO POSSO CULPA-LOS.  A VIDA BASEADA EM CARBONO DEVE PARECER ALGO COMO UM VIRUS PARA ELES.  APENAS MESMO, ESPERO QUE A EXPLOSAO FUNCIONE.  PARECE QUE NESTE PONTO SOMOS NOS OU ELES.  MCCONNELL FORA.

items.english: IT IS WITH THE SINCEREST GRATITUDE FROM THE PEOPLE OF ARTH AND THE STOCKHOLDERS OF INTERSTEL THAT I PRESENT TO YOU AND YOUR HEROIC CREW THE INTERSTEL MEDAL OF SUBLIME ACHIEVEMENT, THE HIGHEST HONOR ACCORDED TO INTERSTEL CONTRACTORS.    THIS AWARD INCLUDES A SPECIAL BONUS OF 500,000 MU WHEN YOU RETURN TO STARPORT.  THANK YOU FOR SAVING EVERYTHING THAT WE HOLD DEAR.    -- LEIGH V. MALONE, CHAIRMAN OF INTERSTEL.
items.portuguese: E COM A MAIS SINCERA GRATIDAO DO POVO DA ARTH E DOS ACIONISTAS DA INTERSTEL QUE APRESENTO A VOCE E A SUA HEROICA EQUIPE A MEDALHA INTERSTEL DE SUBLIME REALIZACAO, A MAIS ALTA HONRA CONCEDIDA AOS EMPREITEIROS DA INTERSTEL.    ESTE PREMIO INCLUI UM BONUS ESPECIAL DE 500.000 MU QUANDO VOCE VOLTAR AO STARPORT.  OBRIGADO POR SALVAR TUDO O QUE PRECISAMOS.    - LEIGH V. MALONE, PRESIDENTE DA INTERSTEL.

items.english: qxHAIL TO THEE AND WELL MET ARE WE.  THOU ART WELCOME, FRIENDS OF THE ELOWAN.
items.portuguese: qxHAIL TO THEE AND WELL MET ARE WE.  THOU ART WELCOME, FRIENDS OF THE ELOWAN.

items.english: AGAIN WE ARE MET AND HAPLY SO.  UNTO THEE WE OFFER WHAT SMALL WISDOM WE HAVE ACQUIRED.  WHAT SAY YOU?
items.portuguese: NOVAMENTE ESTAMOS ENCONTRADOS E FELIZMENTE.  A TI OFERECEMOS A PEQUENA SABEDORIA QUE ADQUIRIMOS.  O QUE VOCE DIZ?

items.english: IN FRIENDSHIP WE GREET THEE, FELLOW TRAVELLERS OF ETERNAL NIGHT.  FEAR NOT THE ELOWAN WHO SEEK THAT WHICH THOU DOST ALSO, THE LIGHT OF KNOWLEDGE AND THE PEACE OF UNDERSTANDING.
items.portuguese: EM AMIZADE, SAUDAMOS-VOS, COMPANHEIROS VIAJANTES DA NOITE ETERNA.  NAO TEMAS OS ELOWAN QUE PROCURAM O QUE TU TAMBEM, A LUZ DO CONHECIMENTO E A PAZ DA COMPREENSAO.

items.english: HAIL AND WELCOME.  \TIS OUR REQUEST THAT THOU IDENTIFIEST THYSELF FORTHWITH.  WE ARE ELOWAN AND WOULD HAVE PEACE BETWEEN US.
items.portuguese: SALVE E BEM-VINDO.  E NOSSO PEDIDO QUE VOCE SE IDENTIFIQUE IMEDIATAMENTE.  SOMOS ELOWAN E TEREMOS PAZ ENTRE NOS.

items.english: STATEST THOU THINE INTENTIONS AND NAME THYSELF.  WE GREET THEE IN PEACE IF THOU GREETEST US IN LIKE MEASURE.  WE ARE ELOWAN, AND WE BEAR THEE NO MALICE.
items.portuguese: DECLARE SUAS INTENCOES E NOMEIE-SE.  SAUDAMOS-TE EM PAZ SE NOS SAUDARS NA MESMA MEDIDA.  SOMOS ELOWAN E NAO TE TEMOS MALICIA.

items.english: HAIL.  ART THOU FRIENDS OR FOE OF THE ELOWAN?  WE ASK THEE IN FRIENDSHIP AND WOULD HAVE IT BE THUS BETWEEN US.  THE CHOICE IS THINE.
items.portuguese: SALVAR.  VOCE E AMIGO OU INIMIGO DO ELOWAN?  TE PEDIMOS EM AMIZADE E QUEREMOS QUE SEJA ASSIM ENTRE NOS.  A ESCOLHA E TUA.

items.english: GREETINGS AND SALUTATIONS MOST GRAND, FRIENDS OF THE ELOWAN.  WE WOULDST HELP THEE IN ANY WAY WE CAN.  PRAY, HOW MIGHT WE BE OF SERVICE?
items.portuguese: SAUDACOES E SAUDACOES GRANDES, AMIGOS DO ELOWAN.  NOS TE AJUDAMOS DE QUALQUER MANEIRA QUE PUDERMOS.  ORE, COMO PODEMOS SER DE SERVICO?

items.english: WE OFFER SALUTATIONS MOST SINCERE.  THOU ART WELL MET, AND WELCOME HERE.
items.portuguese: OFERECEMOS SAUDACOES MAIS SINCERAS.  ESTAS BEM CONHECIDO E BEM-VINDO AQUI.

items.english: WE EXTEND UNTO THEE THE VINE OF FRIENDSHIP.  IF THOU WOULDST HAVE IT SO, WE WOULD SHARE WITH THEE WHAT WE KNOW.
items.portuguese: ESTENDEMOS A TI A VIDEIRA DA AMIZADE.  SE VOCE ASSIM, COMPARTILHAREMOS COM VOCE O QUE SABEMOS.

items.english: WE ARE ELOWAN.  IF THINE INTENTIONS BE PEACEFUL IN SOOTH, WE GREET THEE.  IF NOT, WE REQUEST THAT THOU LEAVEST US WHO BEAR THEE NO ILL WILL.
items.portuguese: SOMOS ELOWAN.  SE SUAS INTENCOES FOREM PACIFICAS, NOS TE SAUDAMOS.  SE NAO, SOLICITAMOS QUE DEIXE-NOS QUE NAO TE TENHA MAL VONTADE.

items.english: WE ARE ELOWAN, AND ABOVE ALL ELSE DO WE CHERISH PEACE.  IF THOU ART OF LIKE MIND, WE WELCOME THEE.
items.portuguese: SOMOS ELOWAN E ACIMA DE TUDO VALORIZAMOS A PAZ.  SE VOCE TEM A MENTE, NOS TE BEM-VINDO.

items.english: WE ENTREAT THEE FROM VIOLENCE REFRAIN, FOR NOTHING MORE DO WE DISDAIN, AND IN SO DOING ALL THAT WE MIGHT GAIN, WOULD BE FOREVER LOST, LIKE TEARS IN RAIN.
items.portuguese: NOS TE EXORTAMOS A EVITAR A VIOLENCIA, POIS NADA MAIS DESPREZAMOS E, AO FAZE-LO, TUDO O QUE PUDESSEMOS GANHAR, SERIA PARA SEMPRE PERDIDO, COMO LAGRIMAS NA CHUVA.

items.english: PRAY FORGIVE ME, BUT I KNOW LITTLE OF SUCH THINGS.  PERHAPS YOU MIGHT ASK THIS OF ANOTHER.
items.portuguese: POR FAVOR, ME PERDOE, MAS SEI POUCO DESSAS COISAS.  TALVEZ VOCE PODE PERGUNTAR ISSO A OUTRO.

items.english: WHAT SAYEST THOU?
items.portuguese: O QUE VOCE DIZ?

items.english: I WAIT ON THY ANSWER.
items.portuguese: ESPERO SUA RESPOSTA.

items.english: IT IS WITH THE THEORY OF SCIENCE THAT WE ARE, OURSELVES CONCERN\D, AND SUCH THINGS AS MAY BE CALLED BEAUTY AND PERHAPS TRUTH.
items.portuguese: E COM A TEORIA DA CIENCIA QUE ESTAMOS, NOS MESMOS PREOCUPADOS, E COM COISAS QUE PODEM SER CHAMADAS DE BELEZA E TALVEZ DE VERDADE.

items.english: NOW BUT FEW OF US REMAIN, FOR THE SUN\S FLARE DID OUR SECOND HOMEWORLD DESTROY, AND AS WELL ARE WE PREYED UPON BY THE THRYNN, RELENTLESS AND COLD.
items.portuguese: AGORA, MAS POUCOS DE NOS RESTAM, POIS O FLARE DO SOL DESTRUIU NOSSO SEGUNDO MUNDO LAR, E TAMBEM SOMOS PRESADOS PELO THRYNN, IMPLACAVEL E FRIO.

items.english: AT A TIME WHEN WE DOTH REACH AN AGE OF ADOLESCENCE WE ARE UPROOTED.  IN SO DOING WE ARE BECOME OMNIVOROUS PRODUCERS UNTIL THAT TIME WHEN AGAIN WE MUST ROOT, WHEREUPON OUR HEADS INTO FLOWERS TURN AND WE REPRODUCE.
items.portuguese: NUMA EPOCA EM QUE ATINGIMOS A IDADE DA ADOLESCENCIA, SOMOS DESENRAIZADOS.  AO FAZE-LO, NOS TORNAMOS PRODUTORES ONIVOROS ATE AQUELE MOMENTO EM QUE NOVAMENTE DEVEMOS ENRAIZAR, ONDE NOSSAS CABECAS SE TRANSFORMAM EM FLORES E NOS REPRODUZIMOS.

items.english: MAYHAP ONE OF EVERY 300 OF OUR NUMBER DOTH STAY ROOTED WITHIN THE GROUND, AND IN SO DOING IS ITS HEAD THEN TRANSFORMED INTO A MELON-LIKE FRUIT CALLED HEADFRUIT WHEREIN LIE THE MANY SEEDS OF OUR FUTURE.
items.portuguese: TALVEZ UM EM CADA 300 DE NOSSOS NUMEROS FIQUE ENRAIZADO NO SOLO, E, AO FAZER ASSIM, SUA CABECA SE TRANSFORME EM UMA FRUTA SEMELHANTE A MELAO, CHAMADA CABECA, ONDE ESTAO AS MUITAS SEMENTES DE NOSSO FUTURO.

items.english: HEADFRUIT IS OF ALL THINGS, TO US, MOST DEAR.  UPON CLAIMING THAT IT DOST BESTOW GREATER INTELLIGENCE AND INCREASE THE SPAN OF LIFE DO THE SLY THRYNN THIEVE AND CONSUME THIS FRUIT.  SO HAVE WE BEEN ENEMIES, AND SO SHALL WE ALWAYS BE.
items.portuguese: A CABECA E DE TODAS AS COISAS, PARA NOS, A MAIS QUERIDA.  AO ALEGAR QUE ELE DA MAIOR INTELIGENCIA E AUMENTA A TEMPO DE VIDA, FACA O LADRAO SLY THRYNN E CONSUMA ESTA FRUTA.  ASSIM FOMOS INIMIGOS E SEMPRE SEREMOS INIMIGOS.

items.english: NO OTHER PLANET IS SO SACRED AS ELAN.  FOR THERE DO OUR YOUNG ABIDE, AND IN TRANQUILLITY DWELL.  NOT EVEN THOSE OF US GROWN DISTURB THEIR MEDITATIONS THERE.  AN ISLAND WORLD, WITH OCEANS VAST AND SPLENDOROUS, ELAN REVOLVES ABOUT THE YELLOW SUN OF 148,63.
items.portuguese: NENHUM OUTRO PLANETA E TAO SAGRADO COMO ELAN.  POIS LA NOSSO JOVEM HABITA E NA TRANQUILIDADE HABITA.  NEM AQUELES DE NOS CRESCEMOS PERTURBA SUAS MEDITACOES LA.  UM MUNDO ILHA, COM OCEANOS VASTOS E ESPLENDOROSOS, ELAN GIRA SOBRE O SOL AMARELO DE 148,63.

items.english: IS NOT VIOLENCE, ABOVE ALL THINGS, MOST BASE AND VILE?  SURELY ONLY AS A FINAL MEASURE, AND EVEN THEN WITH RESERVATION, CAN IT BE CONDONED.
items.portuguese: A VIOLENCIA NAO E, ACIMA DE TODAS AS COISAS, A MAIS BASE E VILE?  COM CERTEZA SO COMO MEDIDA FINAL, E MESMO ASSIM COM RESERVA, PODE SER PERDOADA.

items.english: THE STAR OF OUR BIRTH WAS ALSO THAT OF THE THRYNN.  TOGETHER THERE WE DWELT AS THEY DO STILL, TILL WE FLED HITHER, LEST THEY DESTROY US AT LAST.
items.portuguese: A ESTRELA DO NOSSO NASCIMENTO TAMBEM FOI A DO THRYNN.  JUNTOS LA MORAREMOS COMO ELES AINDA FAZEM, ATE FUGIMOS PARA CA, PARA QUE ELES NOS DESTRUIRAM FINALMENTE.

items.english: THE ORANGE STAR OF OUR BIRTH, AT 129,33, WAS NAMED ELERAN, AND BY THE THRYNN THOSS.  AND UPON THE SECOND PLANET DID WE DWELL, AND THEY UPON THE FOURTH.
items.portuguese: A ESTRELA LARANJA DO NOSSO NASCIMENTO, A 129,33, FOI NOMEADA ELERAN, E PELO THRYNN THOSS.  E NO SEGUNDO PLANETA HORAMOS, E ELES NO QUARTO.

items.english: AS OUR YOUNG PLAY OFTEN DO THEY SING SONGS SUCH AS THIS -- SOMEDAY TO THE GROUND WILL FALL, IRIDANI, ECHT, AND GAAL.  UP THEY\LL GROW WITH BRANCHES TALL, THEN TO AKTERON THEY\LL CALL.  AND AT LAST IT TOO WILL FALL.  THE BRIGHTEST SEEDLING OF THEM ALL.
items.portuguese: COMO NOSSOS JOVENS JOVENS FAZEM COM FREQUENCIA, ELES CANTAM CANCOES COMO ESTA - ALGUM DIA NO CHAO CAIRA, IRIDANI, ECHT E GAAL.  ACIMA ELES CRESCERAO COM RAMOS ALTOS, ENTAO PARA AKTERON ELES VAO CHAMAR.  E FINALMENTE TAMBEM CAIRA.  A MUDA MAIS BRILHANTE DE TODAS.

items.english: PLACE NOT YOUR TRUST IN THE THRYNN, FOR THEY ARE NOT WHAT THEY WOULD APPEAR TO BE AND WOULD DO THEE HARM SHOULD THEY BE GIVEN CHANCE TO DO SO.
items.portuguese: NAO COLOQUE SUA CONFIANCA NOS THRYNN, POIS ELES NAO SAO O QUE PARECERIAM SER E FARIAM-TE PREJUIZO SE ELES TIVEREM OPORTUNIDADE DE FAZE-LO.

items.english: THE CULTURE OF THE THRYNN EMBRACES THE MACHINE.  THEY ARE ADVANCED AND YET WITHIN THEM THOU WILT GREAT IGNORANCE FIND, FOR THEY KNOW NOT EVEN THAT IN NINE-MONTH OF THIS YEAR THEIR SUN SHALL FLARE, NOR SHALL WE, WHO BEAR THEM NO GREAT LOVE, TELL THEM.
items.portuguese: A CULTURA DO THRYNN ABRACA A MAQUINA.  ELES SAO AVANCADOS E AINDA DENTRO DELES ENCONTRARAS GRANDE IGNORANCIA, POIS NAO SABEM MESMO QUE EM NOVE MESES DESTE ANO SEU SOL BRILHARA, NEM NOS, QUE NAO TEMOS GRANDE AMOR, DAREMOS A ELES.

items.english: CONSTANT AND FIERCE HAVE BEEN THE ATTACKS OF THE VILE THRYNN, E\ER SINCE THE EMPIRE FELL AND COULD NO LONGER JUDGE THEM.
items.portuguese: CONSTANTES E FEROZES FORAM OS ATAQUES DO VILE THRYNN, DESDE QUE O IMPERIO CAIU E NAO PODERIA MAIS JULGA-LOS.

items.english: KNOW THEE THIS, THAT THE HOMEWORLDS OF ALL RACES ARE WELL GUARDED AND THITHER THOU MAYEST NOT DESCEND.  EVEN IF THOU ART FRIENDS WILL THEY NOT SUFFER THEE TO VIOLATE THAT FINAL BASTION.  WELL HAS THIS LESSON BEEN LEARN\D BY ALL RACES.
items.portuguese: SAIBA ISTO, QUE OS MUNDOS DOMESTICOS DE TODAS AS RACAS ESTAO BEM GUARDADOS E PARA LA NAO PODES DESCIDA.  MESMO QUE VOCES SEJAM AMIGOS, ELES NAO TE PERMITIRAO VIOLAR ESSE BASTIAO FINAL.  BEM, ESTA LICAO FOI APRENDIDA POR TODAS AS RACAS.

items.english: INTERESTING INDEED ARE THE ANCIENT VELOXI, FOR THEY ARE POSSESSED OF BOTH GREAT WISDOM AND GREAT IGNORANCE.  IN MATTERS OF THE ANCIENTS THEIR ARROGANCE BREEDS FALSE WISDOM.
items.portuguese: INTERESSANTES SAO OS ANTIGOS VELOXI, POIS SAO POSSUIDOS DE GRANDE SABEDORIA E GRANDE IGNORANCIA.  II EM QUESTOES DOS ANTIGOS, SUA ARROGANCIA CRIA FALSA SABEDORIA.

items.english: MEETING THEE HAS BEEN NO SMALL SURPRISE, FOR \TWAS OUR BELIEF THAT THE COLONY WORLDS OF THE EMPIRE HAD BEEN DESTROYED ALL HERETOFORE.
items.portuguese: ENCONTRAR-TE NAO FOI PEQUENA SURPRESA, POIS ERA NOSSA CRENCA QUE OS MUNDOS COLONIOS DO IMPERIO FORAM DESTRUIDOS ATE AGORA.

items.english: THE SPEMIN KNOWETH LITTLE AND MOSTLY DO THEY BLUSTER.  UPON PAMPERING SHALT THOU APPEASE THEM, BUT THAT WHICH IS USEFUL SHALT THOU GAIN ONLY BY FORCE.
items.portuguese: O SPEMIN SABE POUCO E MAIORIAMENTE FAZ BLUSTER.  AO MIMAR VOCE OS APAZIGUARA, MAS O QUE FOR UTIL VOCE GANHARA APENAS PELA FORCA.

items.english: STRONGEST OF MANY RACES ARE THE UHLEK, AND AS WELL THE GAZURTOID, WHO HAVE FLED THE WAVE OF FLARING SUNS.  IN SOOTH, ONLY THOSE WHO ARE STRONGEST HAVE SURVIVED.
items.portuguese: A MAIS FORTE DE MUITAS RACAS SAO OS UHLEK, E TAMBEM OS GAZURTOID, QUE FUGIRAM DA ONDA DE SOIS ALARGADOS.  NA VERDADE, SO OS QUE SAO MAIS FORTES SOBREVIVERAM.

items.english: LONGER THAN ANY OTHER RACE HAVE THE UHLEK FLED.  FROM THE CENTER OF THE GALAXY THEY HAVE COME HITHER, AND SO SHALL THEY CONTINUE, FOR WITH THE PASSAGE OF EACH 100 SCORE YEARS THEY AGAIN JOURNEY OUTWARD.
items.portuguese: MAIS DO QUE QUALQUER OUTRA RACA, O UHLEK FUGIU.  DO CENTRO DA GALAXIA ELES VIERAM PARA CA, E ASSIM DEVERAO CONTINUAR, POIS COM A PASSAGEM DE CADA 100 ANOS DE PONTUACAO ELES NOVAMENTE VIAJAM PARA FORA.

items.english: THE UHLEK ARE A RACE LIKE NONE OTHER.  AS IF CELLS OF ONE LARGE CREATURE, AUTONOMOUS YET ONE, THEY ARE POSSESSED OF A SINGLE MIND WHICH RESIDES APART FROM THEM, BURIED DEEP IN SUBTERRANEAN CAVERNS.
items.portuguese: OS UHLEK SAO UMA RACA COMO NENHUMA OUTRA.  COMO SE CELULAS DE UMA GRANDE CRIATURA, AUTONOMA AINDA UNICA, ESTAO POSSUIDAS DE UMA UNICA MENTE QUE RESIDE A PARTE DELAS, ENTERRADA PROFUNDAMENTE EM CAVERNAS SUBTERRANEAS.

items.english: SO LONG HAVE THE GAZURTOID BEEN TRAVELLING OUTWARD THEY HAVE FORGOTTEN WHY THEY MUST MIGRATE.  THEY KNOW ONLY THAT THEY ARE ON A HOLY CRUSADE.
items.portuguese: HA TANTO TEMPO QUE OS GAZURTOID VIAJAM PARA FORA, ESQUECERAM-SE DO MOTIVO PELO QUAL DEVEM MIGRAR.  ELES SABEM SO QUE ESTAO EM UMA SANTA CRUZADA.

items.english: EXPECT LITTLE FROM THE GAZURTOID FOR THEY OFFER LITTLE.  WASTE NOT YOUR TIME IN VAIN EFFORT TO LEARN FROM THEM.
items.portuguese: ESPERE POUCO DOS GAZURTOID POIS ELES OFERECEM POUCO.  NAO PERCA SEU TEMPO EM VAO ESFORCO PARA APRENDER COM ELES.

items.english: THE UHLEK SPEAK ONLY WITH THEIR WEAPONS.  \TIS OUR THOUGHT THAT THOU WOULD\ST NOT CARE MUCH FOR WHAT THEY HAVE TO SAY.
items.portuguese: OS UHLEK FALAM SOMENTE COM SUAS ARMAS.  E NOSSO PENSAMENTO QUE VOCE NAO SE IMPORTARIA MUITO COM O QUE ELES TEM A DIZER.

items.english: THE WANDERING CREATURES OF SPACE HAVE BEEN CALLED BY MANY \THE MINSTRELS\, AND BY SOME  \DELASA\ALIA\.  THEY ARE OLD BEYOND COUNTING AND WISE IN LIKE MEASURE.
items.portuguese: AS CRIATURAS ERRADAS DO ESPACO FORAM CHAMADAS POR MUITOS \OS MENESTREIS\, E POR ALGUNS \DELASA\ALIA\.  ELES SAO VELHOS ALEM DA CONTA E SABIOS NA MEDIDA.

items.english: THE MINSTRELS, ALONE OF ALL RACES, REQUIRE NO VESSEL IN THE DEPTHS OF SPACE.  ONLY DO THEY WANDER AND SING OF WHAT WAS.  LITTLE DO WE KNOW OF THAT WHICH LIES WITHIN THE HEARTS OF THE DELASA\ALIA.
items.portuguese: OS MENESTRES, SOZINHOS DE TODAS AS RACAS, NAO EXIGEM NENHUMA VASA NAS PROFUNDIDADES DO ESPACO.  SO VAGUEAM E CANTAM O QUE FOI.  POUCO SABEMOS DO QUE ESTA DENTRO DOS CORACOES DA DELASA\ALIA.

items.english: THE SUN OF THE PLANET THOU CALL\ST ARTH SHALL FLARE IN THE FINAL WEEK OF YOUR TEN-MONTH OF THIS YEAR, SO WE HAVE ASCERTAINED.
items.portuguese: O SOL DO PLANETA QUE VOCE CHAMOU ARTH DEVERA BRILHAR NA ULTIMA SEMANA DO SEU DEZ MES DESTE ANO, ASSIM VERIFIQUEMOS.

items.english: AKTERON, GAAL, IRIDANI, AND ECHT.  THESE ARE THE SUNS OF THE FOUR SEEDLINGS, A CONSTELLATION IN OUR DEMESNE OFT USED AS A LANDMARK BY OUR PEOPLE.
items.portuguese: AKTERON, GAAL, IRIDANI E ECHT.  ESTES SAO OS SOIS DAS QUATRO MUDAS, UMA CONSTELACAO EM NOSSO DEMESNE, MUITO USADA COMO MARCO PELO NOSSO POVO.

items.english: COREWARD DOES THE DEAD-ZONE LIE.  IN THIS REGION NO LIVING THING SHALT THOU FIND, FOR THE CRYSTAL PLANET HAS PASSED HERE AND LEFT NAUGHT BEHIND.
items.portuguese: COREWARD FAZ A MENTIRA DA ZONA MORTA.  NESTA REGIAO NAO ENCONTRARAS COISA VIVA, POIS O PLANETA CRISTAL PASSOU POR AQUI E NAO DEIXOU NADA PARA TRAS.

items.english: OUTWARD OF THE DEAD-ZONE LIES THE ZONE INTERMEDIATE.  HERE THE CRYSTAL PLANET ORBITS, COMPLETING ITS TASK ERE IT MOVES ON.
items.portuguese: FORA DA ZONA MORTA ESTA A ZONA INTERMEDIARIA.  AQUI O PLANETA CRISTAL ORBITA, COMPLETANDO SUA TAREFA ANTES DE SEGUIR.

items.english: \TWAS IN 2770 THAT THE EMPIRE DID DISCOVER OUR HOME SYSTEM OF ELERAN.  CONTACT FIRST WAS MADE WITH THE WRETCHED THRYNN.  THEREFORE WERE WE NOT AT FIRST ACCEPTED AS SENTIENT FOR THEY SPOKE WRONGLY OF US AND WERE NOT QUESTIONED IN THEIR SLANDER.
items.portuguese: FOI EM 2770 QUE O IMPERIO DESCOBRIU NOSSO SISTEMA DOMESTICO DE ELERAN.  O CONTATO PRIMEIRO FOI FEITO COM O MIRA THRYNN.  PORTANTO NAO FOMOS A PRIMEIRO ACEITOS COMO SENTIENTES PORQUE FALARAM ERRADAMENTE DE NOS E NAO FORAM QUESTIONADOS EM SUAS CALUNAS.

items.english: WHEN THRYNN AND ELOWAN FIRST WERE TAKEN INTO THE EMPIRE THE THRYNN NURTURED A PROFANE SEED.  THE SALE OF HEADFRUIT ON THE BLACK MARKET QUICK BECAME A TENACIOUS WEED THAT SURVIVED TO THE FINAL DAYS OF THE EMPIRE.
items.portuguese: QUANDO THRYNN E ELOWAN FORAM LEVADOS PARA O IMPERIO, THRYNN NUTRIU UMA SEMENTE PROFANA.  A VENDA DE CABECA NO MERCADO NEGRO RAPIDAMENTE SE TORNOU UMA ERVA TENAZ QUE SOBREVIVIU ATE OS ULTIMOS DIAS DO IMPERIO.

items.english: THE ANCIENT ONES, WHO ARE NO MORE, ARE THE OLDEST OF ALL RACES.  LITTLE DO WE KNOW OF THEM BUT FOR THE SONGS OF THE MINSTRELS.  \TWAS FROM ANOTHER GALAXY, FAR DISTANT, THAT THEY CAME, OR SO IT IS SUNG.
items.portuguese: OS ANTIGOS, QUE NAO EXISTEM MAIS, SAO OS MAIS ANTIGOS DE TODAS AS RACAS.  POUCO SABEMOS SOBRE ELES, EXCETO PELAS CANCOES DOS MENESTREIS.  FOI DE OUTRA GALAXIA, MUITO DISTANTE, QUE ELES VIERAM, OU ASSIM E CANTADO.

items.english: IF THE MINSTREL SONGS BE TRUE THE SPAN OF AN ANCIENT ONE\S LIFE WAS MEASURED NOT IN YEARS, BUT RATHER IN MILLENIA, SO LONG-LIVED WERE THEY.
items.portuguese: SE AS CANCOES DO MINSTREL FOREM VERDADEIRAS, A VIDA DE UM ANTIGO NAO FOI MEDIDA EM ANOS, MAS EM MILENIOS, TAO VIVERAM.

items.english: THE VELOX, IN THEIR BOASTFUL PRIDE, LAY CLAIM TO BE DESCENDANTS OF THE ANCIENT ONES.  HEED NOT SUCH CONCEITFUL FOLLY.
items.portuguese: OS VELOX, EM SEU ORGULHO ORGULHOSO, REIVINDICAM SER DESCENDENTES DOS ANTIGOS.  II NAO PRESTE ATENCAO A ESSA LOUCURA ARROGANTE.

items.english: MAYHAP NONE HAVE KNOWN MORE OF THE ANCIENT ONES THAN THE INSTITUTE OF THE OLD EMPIRE OF EARTH.  BUT ALACK, WITH THE FALL OF THE EMPIRE THE KNOWLEDGE WAS LOST, FOR NONE, NOT EVEN WE, KNEW THE LOCATION OF ITS FINAL HIDING PLACE AMONG THE STARS.

items.english: \TIS NOT KNOWN WHETHER ANY ANCIENT ONES SURVIVE STILL.  MAYHAP ONLY THAT HEINOUS LEGACY, THE CRYSTAL PLANET, HAS BEEN LEFT US.  ITS EVIL TASK IS TO DESTROY ALL THAT LIVES. WHY, WE KNOW NOT.

items.english: UPON APPROACHING THE CRYSTAL PLANET IT DOTH UNLEASH A MIGHTY FORCE, SO TAKE CARE.  ONLY THE POSSESSION OF A CERTAIN DEVICE WILL STAY THIS.  THE NATURE OF THIS DEVICE WAS PERCHANCE KNOWN TO THOSE OF THE INSTITUTE, BUT IT IS UNBEKNOWNST TO US.
items.portuguese: AO SE APROXIMAR DO PLANETA CRISTALINO, ELE LIBERA UMA FORCA PODEROSA, ENTAO TOME CUIDADO.  SOMENTE A POSSE DE UM DETERMINADO DISPOSITIVO PERMANECERA ASSIM.  A NATUREZA DESTE DISPOSITIVO ERA TALVEZ CONHECIDA PELOS DO INSTITUTO, MAS E DESCONHECIDA POR NOS.

items.english: \TIS KNOWN TO US THAT UPON THE CRYSTAL PLANET THERE IS ONE PLACE ONLY THAT IS VULNERABLE TO ATTACK.  OFT HAVE WE TRIED AND FAILED, FOR EVEN THIS NEXUS OF CONTROL IS ALL BUT IMPREGNABLE.

items.english: IF THOU WOULDST MAKE ATTACK UPON THE ANCIENT PLANET OF CRYSTAL FIRSTLY MUST THOU FIND THE NEXUS OF CONTROL.  TO DO THIS THOU WOULDST REQUIRE THAT WHICH IS LOST, THE CONE OF CRYSTAL FASHIONED BY THE ANCIENT ONES.

items.english: THOU ART WISE IN THY PEACEFUL DEALINGS, FOR THE PATH TO KNOWLEDGE DOTH LIE THEREIN.  WERE THAT ALL RACES WERE MINDED SO.

items.english: AGAIN WE ARE AS WE ONCE WERE WITH THOSE FEW OF YOUR KIND, ALLIES IN THE CAUSE OF TRUTH AND THE SEARCH FOR WISDOM.  THIS IS AS IT SHOULD BE, IS IT NOT?
